text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
To the both of you, thank you for the 
birthday gifts earlier.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
CD analysis results indicate a birthday 
song arranged from the track made when 
Nigeshi was formed. Status effect 
"Nostalgia" has been triggered.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. I talked it over with Falcon-senpai, 
and we figured this would be best coming 
from the two of us.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Yep, yep! It's where our roots lie, and a 
song full of memories☆

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Back then, there were only the three of 
us, and we were just a fledgling unit that 
barely managed to perform at school talent 
shows, but—

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
I just knew it deep down! That with the 
two of you, we'd become a group beloved by 
everyone one day!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I concur. The status condition that 
manifested back then— "Passion"—remains 
active to this day.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
At first, I got dragged around a bit, 
but... ...Yeah. I think Nige-Sis is a 
great unit too.

text_block_list.name: Smart Falcon
text_block_list.text:
Uuu~~, I love you both so, so much! Let's 
keep running in the lead together 
foreveeer!!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Today's events, and the song you gave 
me... They will be etched deeply into my 
memory.
